drhp.business: RIR Power Electronics manufactures low- and high-power semiconductor devices (diodes, thyristors, thyristor modules and bridge rectifiers), processing semiconductor chips from 28 mm to 125 mm in diameter at its Halol, Gujarat facility. It also makes power electronic equipment such as rectifiers, battery chargers, high-power stacks and rectifier panels, plus rectifier systems for green hydrogen electrolysis. Customers are in defence, aerospace, railways and industrial applications, and the company is developing next-generation Silicon Carbide (SiC) power devices.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Build domestic Silicon Carbide (SiC) semiconductor manufacturing at the Bhubaneswar, Odisha facility, aligned with Make in India, to reduce India's reliance on imported SiC components
- Grow presence in railways, defence, renewable energy, grid infrastructure and other critical applications
- Establish itself as a domestic technology partner for defence through qualified high-power semiconductor solutions
- Keep product innovation (for example, high-energy pulse-power switches) central to growth and widen the technology-led product portfolio
- Expand exports, starting with the first overseas order …
